capacity_usable_kwh.notes: The Weekly Driver: Large (2022-24) 135 kWh total, 128.6 usable (as published). Conflicts: InsideEVs 554265 reports discharge readings of about 125-128 kWh and says usable may be 5-7.5 % lower; a forum post quoting Rivian support says 131.

chemistry.notes: autoevolution: earlier Large pack uses Samsung 50G NCA 2170 cells.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: EPA filing relayed by InsideEVs: pack voltage 216-459 V, the 400 V class.

preconditioning.notes: Navigation-triggered battery preconditioning plus manual battery preconditioning (no longer forced to use navigation) added by software 2025.18 for Gen 1 and Gen 2 (current state for owners). Before 2025.18 it was navigation-only.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: InsideEVs: Gen 1 Large pack rated 135 kWh (rated capacity, not stated as usable); InsideEVs EPA article says about 135 kWh, 7,776 cells.

dc_max_kw.notes: EPA filing relayed by InsideEVs (135 kWh Large pack): DC fast charging peaks at 210 kW. Wikipedia text says up to 225 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs quoting the EPA filing for the Gen 1 R1: 11.5 kW onboard charger. Wikipedia lists 11.52 kW (240 V, 48 A).
